name: oh-my-agents
description: Lean harness-engineering plugin for Claude Code: four pillars (architecture, documentation, observability, entropy) enforced as repo-local mechanical constraints. Composes with gstack (v1.46+ floor, v1.84.1 current; reconciles its content-addressed review verdicts read-only) for delivery — never orchestrates. Emits versioned verify/review decision signals (a Gate API per docs/SIGNALS.md — one freshness predicate with optional gstack wtree, typed failures[]/findings[] hand-backs) and renders them as a gate ladder at SessionStart (model) and Stop (human) so Dynamic Workflows, Agent Teams and the pre-ship check advance without human round-trips. 11 skills, 6 hooks, 1 read-only audit workflow (/oh-my-agents:harness-audit).
